# Pointzero

> Pointzero is a digital product studio in Kathmandu, Nepal. We design and ship modern websites, mobile apps, custom software, and AI / RAG (retrieval‑augmented generation) products for startups and enterprises in Nepal and worldwide.

**Founded:** 2019  ·  **Location:** Kathmandu, Nepal  ·  **Working area:** Worldwide
**Contact:** hi.pointzero@gmail.com  ·  +977‑9860486269
**Website:** https://pointzero.com.np

## What Pointzero does

- AI & RAG software development — retrieval‑augmented chatbots, AI agents, document & PDF extraction, LLM workflows
- Web development — React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL
- Mobile app development — Flutter, React Native, native iOS (Swift), native Android (Kotlin)
- Custom software development — internal tools, SaaS platforms, marketplaces
- UI / UX design — research, design systems, conversion‑focused interfaces
- Software QA and testing — manual, automated, performance, security
- Infrastructure & DevOps — AWS, GCP, Vercel, CI/CD, observability
- Dedicated developer teams — embedded engineers, designers and QA

## AI / RAG capabilities (in detail)

- Models: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Llama (open) and others
- Orchestration: LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, custom agent loops
- Vector databases: pgvector (Postgres), Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant
- Retrieval: hybrid search, re‑ranking, evals and grounding with citations
- Patterns: RAG over docs/websites/DBs, AI customer support, multi‑step agents, document extraction, fine‑tuning + LoRA, prompt libraries, offline + online evals
- Production: caching, observability, model routing, cost controls, SLAs

## Why teams pick Pointzero

- We ship — most websites in 2–4 weeks, RAG pilots in 2–3 weeks, MVPs in 6–12 weeks.
- We measure — every release is tied to a conversion or quality metric.
- We stay — monthly support and growth retainers post‑launch.
- We are honest about cost — fixed‑price or T&M with milestones after a free discovery call.

## Selected work

- [WellNepa](https://wellnepa.com) — Nepal's #1 verified coaching marketplace (fitness, nutrition, mental wellness). Built by Pointzero.
- [SajiloDera](https://sajilodera.org) — All‑in‑one Nepali home & transport platform.
- [Bachelor Question Bank](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bachelorquestion.nepali) — Mobile app for Bachelor‑level students in Nepal.
- [PyMentor AI Interview](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pymentor.pymentor) — AI‑powered Python mock interviews with a code playground.
